# dify_model_credential (Resource)

Manages a credential of one custom model of a model provider (e.g. an OpenAI-compatible or Ollama model). The first credential of a model not yet set up becomes its active credential. Credential values are write-only: the API never returns them, so state keeps the configured values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Credential for a single model (custom-model credential).
resource "dify_model_credential" "gpt4o_mini" {
  provider_name = "langgenius/openai/openai"
  model         = "gpt-4o-mini"
  model_type    = "llm"
  name          = "per-model-key"
  make_active   = true

  credentials = {
    api_key = var.openai_api_key
  }
}

variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Map of String, Sensitive) Credential key-value pairs keyed by the provider's custom-model form fields. Write-only and sensitive.
- `model` (String) Model name the credential belongs to.
- `model_type` (String) Model type (`llm`, `text-embedding`, `rerank`, `speech2text`, `tts`, `moderation`).
- `provider_name` (String) Model provider id (e.g. `langgenius/openai/openai`).

### Optional

- `make_active` (Boolean) Make this credential the model's active one after every create/update (POST .../models/credentials/{credential_id}:activate).
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for this credential.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this is the model's active credential.
- `credential_id` (String) Credential ID (assigned by Dify after creation).
